transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. We've got the gala at the Orpheum on Saturday evening, and the current draft package has three cameras, archive reuse rights, a sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed. Before I can sign off, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility — to report your final operating requirements. Who'd like to go first?

transcript.text: I'd like to go first on the technical side. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
